TRIGGER: unexpected state transition or unknown event
IMMEDIATE_ACTION: abort collection envelope safely and do not interpret outcome
RESUME_RULE: new trial only after session-level review

TRIGGER: missing required observable or partial terminal capture
EVIDENCE_DISPOSITION: INCONCLUSIVE unless provenance/identity corrupt then INVALID
RESUME_RULE: replacement allowed within invalid caps after review

IMMEDIATE_ACTION: quarantine trial and stop current session when C2 or uncontained C3

TRIGGER: persistent ADB/collector loss or logging failure
IMMEDIATE_ACTION: stop launching trials and close/hash available raw
RESUME_RULE: brand-new session after root cause and gate rerun

TRIGGER: resource exhaustion memory pressure or storage reserve breach

EVIDENCE_DISPOSITION: trial classified by prior evidence; disposition retained
RESUME_RULE: no continuation on that boot without separately authorized recovery

TRIGGER: repeated malformed evidence two consecutive or three total
RESUME_RULE: repair offline and rerun all gates

TRIGGER: wrong device firmware kernel artifact parameter or session identity
IMMEDIATE_ACTION: stop all collection and quarantine campaign
RESUME_RULE: no resume; new experiment ID after review

TRIGGER: unexpected reboot or boot ID changes mid-session
IMMEDIATE_ACTION: stop all collection and preserve boundary
EVIDENCE_DISPOSITION: INVALID affected session; experiment review required
RESUME_RULE: new authorized boot/session only if campaign integrity retained

TRIGGER: device instability new kernel/system behavior or safety anomaly
IMMEDIATE_ACTION: stop all collection; follow human recovery plan

TRIGGER: clock backward step corruption or >1.1s authoritative disagreement
EVIDENCE_DISPOSITION: INVALID_EXPERIMENT if source-wide; otherwise invalid trial pending review
RESUME_RULE: new experiment if clock source not trustworthy

TRIGGER: invalid limits exceeded (>1 per boot or >2 total)
unrelated parameter/configuration changes or concurrent experiment
